title: DNS
intro: Your domains and the provider accounts that hold them. The keys stay with their owner: other people only ever use the domain.
accounts.title: Provider accounts
accounts.explain: An account belongs to you, not to a machine. Its keys are stored encrypted and never shown again.
accounts.name: A name for yourself
accounts.private: The keys are checked with the provider before they are saved.
domains.title: Domains
domains.name: Domain name
domains.localHint: Local DNS only gives names to your sites and rights: nothing is published.
records.localExplain: This domain uses a local DNS: Armadok cannot read or change its records. The name is only used for your sites and rights.
records.publishIpExplain: This provider only sets the address (A, AAAA) and the TXT value of the name. It cannot list what is set, so the addresses shown are what the name resolves to now.
records.name: Name
report.explain: The names your sites answer to, and whether your DNS knows them.
report.empty: No host in use on this machine yet.
attach.title: Attach this domain to a machine
attach.warning: The people who can change DNS on that machine will change records using YOUR provider account. Choose what they may write. Everything they do is recorded in the audit log under their own name.
attach.apex: Allow the domain itself (apex), not only names below it
attach.namesHint: Comma-separated, for example dev, staging. Empty means any name below the domain. Names starting with an underscore (such as _acme-challenge) are never allowed to members.
domains.unverifiedHint: No provider account proves you own this name, so it never takes priority over a verified domain.
